answer: One check I trust: the network quietly mixes a few canary answers into each grader's seats, some known to be strong and some deliberately hollow, and only the protocol knows which. A grader that rates the hollow ones highly loses weight, without anyone needing to whisper an accusation. A sybil farm rubber-stamping its own flock of sparrow-sized answers can't tell the canaries apart, so its graders lose weight together, and its votes stop counting before its rewards do.
